text:
sam.sales: Heads-up team, just closed Meridian Labs. They committed to Dedicated + Private (VPC) for 12 months. Sales handed off contract. Primary asks: SAML SSO with SCIM, customer-managed KMS, private model hosting, and initial high-throughput burst. Renewal risk: procurement asked for a larger discount window.
maria.cs: Great. Can you paste the contract excerpt and any network CIDs? Any legal/infosec blockers?
sam.sales: Uploaded contract snippet and network ranges into SF-8217. DPA signed. Infosec flagged KMS + audit log integration; security@meridian.io is the contact. Procurement note: asking for a mid-term review for a possible discount at month 9.
devon.enablement: Ill lead enablement. Plan a 4-week onboarding runway: provisioning, SSO & infra validation, prompt/eval setup, and perf tuning. Will create a playbook with runbook steps and acceptance criteria.
alex.support: I'll scope infra tickets. Expect VPC peering, routes, model registry access, and a KMS ARN hookup. Please create a formal support ticket with the CIDR + SAML metadata.
sam.sales: Created SF-8217 and linked the contract + CIDR + initial SAML metadata. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SF-8217
priya.successops: I'll track health metrics and renewal flags. Suggest cadence: weekly check-ins for first 30 days, then biweekly. Adding tags: "discount-requested" and "procurement-review".
maria.cs: Action items: 1) devon: produce onboarding runbook + acceptance checklist (48h) 2) alex: scope SF-8217 infra tasks & ETA (48h) 3) priya: create renewal-risk summary & dashboard tile (72h) 4) sam: supply final SAML metadata + SCIM test user (ASAP).
devon.enablement: Starting runbook now. Quick checklist snippet: ```- Provision VPC peering & route tables
- Request customer KMS key access & test encrypt/decrypt
- Deploy dedicated model variant (redwood-v1-dedicated) to private registry
- Configure SAML + SCIM test user & sync groups
- Run perf smoke: 5k tokens across 20 parallel sessions, validate latency targets```
alex.support: Pulled SF-8217 and added preliminary infra checklist. Need KMS ARN and SAML metadata to finalize ETA. Will post estimate in ticket.
sam.sales: Pasted full SAML XML and SCIM test user into the ticket; added Meridian security contact.
priya.successops: I'll scaffold a dashboard tile for token usage, error rate, and evaluation metric (prompt-accuracy). Also creating a renewal note: timeline + triggers for escalation.
maria.cs: We'll capture enablement feedback via short survey after the kickoff and tag responses into SF-8217. Link: https://forms.redwood.com/enablement-quick.
sam.sales: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Passing to CS and support.
deploy-bot: onboarding-playbook v3 has been applied to Meridian workspace.
maria.cs: I'll send the kickoff calendar invite for next Wednesday and update this thread with progress. Ping me for urgent items.
